canvas.subtitle: An all-in-one creative space combining multi-model capabilities, intelligent creation assistants, and visual workflows
canvas.textGenContent: A breathtaking Eastern fairy clad in a white-blue gradient sheer Hanfu robe, adorned with silver-white floral embroidery. Her hair cascades like a waterfall, decorated with a white jade flower hairpin and pearl earrings. She stands quietly on an immortal palace plaza floating above a sea of clouds. Behind her towers a magnificent white jade celestial gate with intricately carved flying eaves and dougong brackets. In the distance, layered floating immortal mountains pierce through the clouds, with waterfalls cascading from their peaks. Mist swirls around the mountainsides while pink-white cherry blossoms bloom on both sides of the courtyard, petals drifting gently in the breeze. Lotus ponds and white jade railings surround the plaza as dawn sunlight filters through the clouds, casting soft volumetric light — the entire scene is ethereal, sacred, and dreamlike.
canvas.videoContent: The camera slowly pushes forward from a wide shot. The fairy gently turns her head toward the camera, a faint smile appearing on her lips. A gentle breeze flows, her sleeves, ribbons, and long hair moving naturally. Cherry blossom petals dance lightly in the air while mist drifts slowly. The distant waterfall continues to flow as sunlight creates soft highlights on the white jade architecture. The camera finally settles on a medium close-up of the character — cinematic camera movement, natural and fluid motion, realistic fabric simulation, real hair physics, ultra-high detail, hyper-realistic Eastern xianxia style.
